note: Developed on top of the PASS 25 tip (adjudication auth) so it includes #157's changes; will be rebased onto main once #157 merges before opening the PR (no two unmerged feature PRs at once).
schemaChange: None — reuses the persisted ProcessExecutionTask state; no new columns.
falseAttributionProtections: Engine no longer emits 'it appears to be working'.
A measured improvement is attributed only when the correction's persisted task is COMPLETED with evidence.
Improvement without execution proof → IMPROVED_BUT_EXECUTION_NOT_PROVEN (execution-evidence request).
Execution without a post-execution measurement → EXECUTED_BUT_OUTCOME_NOT_PROVEN (reassessment).
Verified improvement is MONITOR_ONLY and NOT completable (cannot be 'completed' to fake success).
Weak completion evidence can never reach a VERIFIED state.
sopAdherenceProtections: SOP adopted (change made) is distinct from SOP followed (adherence-verified).
Adherence VERIFIED requires a post-adoption re-check with evidence; otherwise NEEDS_RECHECK.
trainingEffectivenessProtections: Effectiveness requires a post-training reassessment; weak completion → cannot be verified effective.
